related_issues.reason: Open question about uv add/sync not honouring --active when VIRTUAL_ENV is unset; shows --active semantics are still being worked out and is the closest existing discussion of the flag.
Open bug where uv sync --active recreates the active venv; concerns the same --active flag and the same .venv handling, but asks for different behaviour.
Open enhancement to extend --active to conda environments; same flag, different environment type.

rationale: The reporter asks for a new --active flag on uv lock so it can ignore an invalid .venv, which is a request for new behaviour, so enhancement; this matches the template label. The docs (concepts/projects/sync.md) describe locking as project-level and do not say uv lock needs the project environment, so the failure the reporter sees is arguably a separate bug, and the referenced #19832 did not appear in any of my searches, so I did not list it as a duplicate. No external cause is shown. Searches for --active and for uv lock with a broken .venv found only related issues (#17780, #15603, #11315), none with the same requested outcome. The reporter gives no error text or uv version, but a maintainer can reproduce by creating a .venv with no interpreter, so no MRE is required. Tool coverage was limited to 7 calls and #19832 was not retrievable, so confidence is medium.
